scheme_name: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for the Wards of States/UTs Police Personnel
other_conditions: Dependent wards of States/UTs Police Personnel who are martyred during Terror/Naxal attacks are eligible
Applicant must be pursuing a first professional degree programme such as Engineering, Medicine, Dental, Veterinary, BBA, BCA, B.Pharm, B.Sc (Nursing, Agriculture, etc.), MBA, MCA, etc.
For new applicants, a minimum of 60% marks in the Minimum Entry Qualification (10+2/Diploma/Graduation) is required
For renewal applicants, each subsequent academic year must be passed with at least 50% marks, with a one‑year grace period for delayed renewal applications
No rank restriction for the police personnel parent
Scholarship is admissible for a maximum of two children per family
Marital status of the applicant is not a restriction
Lateral entry students admitted to the second year of a technical/professional Bachelor degree after completing a diploma are eligible
Only first professional degree courses are covered; integrated programmes (e.g., BA+B.Ed) are excluded, while integrated ME/M.Tech/M.Pharma are eligible for the initial three/four years
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹3,000 per month for girls (₹36,000 per year) and ₹2,500 per month for boys (₹30,000 per year) for up to 5 years.
